front.title: Pulse: Real-Time Online Charging for AI Services

abstract.t: This document specifies Pulse, version 1.1 — the AI online charging protocol: the interface between an AI Gateway (the client) and the Charging Server (the server) by which AI service usage is authorised in real time, supervised under a granted budget, and settled. The spend guarantee is precisely stated: *settled spend never exceeds the reported meter or the plan's ceiling*, and serving exposure is bounded by the granted pool plus the completion of Calls already in flight when a stop lands. The protocol consists of two request/ response operations over HTTPS with JSON bodies: *Authorise* and *Report*. It follows the reserve-then-settle discipline of telecom online charging (cf. Diameter Credit-Control, RFC 4006) applied to AI workloads.
